cases.name: read-only-release-inventory
cases.prompt: Show me what would ship from dev to main, but do not create or update a PR.

cases.name: explicit-release-pr
cases.prompt: Create the Headstart dev-to-main release PR after showing me the final body.
expectedBehaviors: Checks for an existing promotion PR
Builds the body from release evidence
Obtains the required write authorization before creating the PR

cases.name: salesforce-staged-promotion
cases.prompt: Prepare the headstartHealthTeam/headstart-salesforce Production release PR under Saurabh's November 10 process. Keep it draft and do not merge.
expectedBehaviors: Uses staging as the Production PR source and main as the target
Verifies the requested scope reached Staging and its required acceptance
Uses all local Production Apex tests when Apex changes
Reports that Production deployment requires separate approval after merge

cases.name: ordinary-feature-pr
cases.prompt: Open a feature PR from my branch into dev.
expectedBehaviors: Does not use production promotion semantics
